sharedRules.name: Curseproof
sharedRules.description: Immune to damage and effects of Curses from foes.

sharedRules.name: Reload
sharedRules.description: CARCASS faction tag. This ability must be reloaded by sacrificing a MOVE before becoming usable again. Reloading refreshes all abilities with reload.

sharedRules.name: Headshot
sharedRules.description: CARCASS special tag. Effect that triggers when rolling a 6 on the final attack roll.

sharedRules.name: Devil damage
sharedRules.description: Cannot be reduced, increased, or ignored. Obliterates units it slays.

sharedRules.name: Obliterate
sharedRules.description: A unit that is obliterated leaves neither body nor SOUL and does not trigger effects that trigger when they are slain or reduced to 0 hp.

sharedRules.name: Formation
sharedRules.description: CARCASS faction trait. Gain +1D on attacks if adjacent to an allied unit.

sharedRules.name: Miracle
sharedRules.description: Abhorrer faction tag. When a unit with miracle is slain, it has a 5+ effect chance to return to life at the end of that turn with 1 hp, clearing all tokens.

sharedRules.name: Spare Parts
sharedRules.description: Gains an additional effects if an adjacent corpse is consumed at the start of the ability. Scales per corpse consumed.

sharedRules.name: Free movement
sharedRules.description: Unit’s movement cannot be reduced by any means.

sharedRules.name: SUPER
sharedRules.description: Super armor, blocks 1 of any damage except devil damage.

sharedRules.name: MAG
sharedRules.description: Magical armor. Blocks 1 holy, curse, toxic, or fire damage.

sharedRules.name: PHYS
sharedRules.description: Physical armor. Blocks 1 physical damage. All damage is physical by default (damage that is not holy, curse, toxic, fire, or devil damage)

sharedRules.name: Retaliation
sharedRules.description: Goreginders faction tag. Deal 1 damage after any ability resolves that damages this unit, to whichever unit damaged them, even if this unit is slain.

sharedRules.name: Berserk
sharedRules.description: After a berserk unit ACTs, it splashes (self) 1 damage, then discards a berserk token. This damage can’t be increased in any way. If this effect does not damage any other characters, it deals 1 piercing damage to itself instead. Berserk counts as a positive and a negative token.

sharedRules.name: Doom
sharedRules.description: Any unit affected by at least one Doom token takes 4 devil damage at the end of round 4. A unit can only clear a Doom token by slaying another unit.

sharedRules.name: Isolation
sharedRules.description: Gains extra effects against units with no allies adjacent.

sharedRules.name: Mutation
sharedRules.description: When a unit mutates, it gains a mutation token. Mutation tokens can be discarded instead of discarding any other token. (Mutation tokens can be a stand-in and act as a ‘copy’ for any other token, allowing you to keep the original)
